SELECT count(*) as last_thirty FROM 
dbo.vw_OTC_DerivSett_RMU_RER_IntellimatchRecCount
WHERE cast(ProcessedDate as date) <= DATEADD(day, -30, cast(getdate()as date))

SELECT count(*) as last_thirty 
FROM tbl_Intellimatch_GL_Monthly_Historical
WHERE reconDate is not null and reconDate <> '' AND cast(ProcessedDate as date) >= (getdate() -30)

SELECT Count(department)
FROM  Reconcontrol.dbo.tbl_OTC_DerivSett_RMU_RER_Departments_Staging
Where Department <> '' AND Department is NOT NULL

sMessageAccnt.defaultValue: SELECT Account as New_Accounts_Found FROM dbo.tbl_OTC_DerivSett_RMU_RER_Accounts_Staging WHERE Account <> '' AND Account is NOT NULL

sLastThirtydays.defaultValue:
SELECT 
distinct max(ProcessedDate) as ProcessedDate, 
Filename, 
Max(reconDate) reconDate ,
recCnt_After, 
recCnt_Before
FROM tbl_Intellimatch_GL_Monthly_Historical
WHERE 
reconDate is not null 
and reconDate <> '' 
AND cast(ProcessedDate as date) >= (getdate() - 30)
GROUP BY  Filename,  recCnt_After,recCnt_Before
order by ProcessedDate desc
